integrity: All theorem statements have self-contained analytical proofs. Finite checker tests are corroborative, not universal certificates. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The global John formula requires no isolated vertices; the finite inner-contact classification requires connectedness and at least three vertices. The outer Löwner and full outer-contact conclusions require connected bipartite biregular graphs. Bibliographic search is nonexhaustive; independent audit is pending.
title: Degree-ellipsoid rigidity and complete contact graphs of bipartite graphical discotopes
